changelog:
Initial release – scrape and extract full Product Hunt launch data, including maker and website contact info.

- Supports scraping daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly Product Hunt leaderboards with product details.
- Extracts product information, maker profiles, and website contact emails/content.
- Step-by-step browser automation with handling for Cloudflare protections.
- Provides structured JSON output for leaderboard, launch detail, maker, and website data.
- Composite workflow enables end-to-end product enrichment for contact/lead generation use cases.
